## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior.

## Validation

List checks actually performed, or explain why they were not run. For documentation-only changes, review links and the diff.

## Data and compatibility

For changes involving saves, imports, rules, or previews, describe compatibility and how backup/isolation requirements in AGENTS.md were followed. Mark not applicable for documentation-only changes.

## Related issue

Link an issue if applicable. Keep personal character data and third-party compendium content out of this pull request.
